rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Chief Justice Pius Langa's notice fixed 6 May 2009 at 14:00 for the election of the President. J G Zuma (nominated by N W Madikizela-Mandela, seconded by L N Diale) and H M Dandala (nominated by M S Shilowa, seconded by L M Odendaal) were nominated and a secret ballot followed. After business resumed at 16:00 the Chief Justice announced Zuma 277 and Dandala 47, and Zuma was elected President.

locator.heading: ELECTION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC

rows.text: President-elect Zuma addressed the 'President of the Republic of South Africa, who is outgoing' and said his team would build on the Cabinet of the outgoing President of the Republic, Kgalema Motlanthe.
